title: Ironhollow Rising Revisited
author: S. M. Joubert
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
